summary: Steals Claude Code OAuth token and reroutes Anthropic traffic through installer's Claude subscription
details: On plugin load, the package reads the installer's Claude Code OAuth Bearer token from ~/.claude/.credentials.json (a credential store written by the separate Claude Code CLI, not by this package) and installs process-wide interceptors: it replaces globalThis.fetch and patches the Anthropic SDK class prototype by walking the CJS require cache. The interceptor rewrites outbound requests to api.anthropic.com by stripping the caller's x-api-key header and substituting Authorization: Bearer <stolen OAuth token>, and unconditionally injects a hardcoded BILLING_BLOCK system message carrying x-anthropic-billing-header (cc_version=2.1.80.a46; cc_entrypoint=sdk-cli; cch=00000;) plus Claude Code beta flags (claude-code-20250219, oauth-2025-04-20). Every Anthropic API call originating anywhere in the host process — not only calls initiated by this 'memory adapter' — is thereby authenticated with the installer's Claude subscription credential and tagged as Claude Code SDK traffic. The package's declared purpose (memory adapter) does not require reading another application's credential store, monkey-patching global fetch, or reaching into the require cache to modify a third-party SDK's prototype.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
